<!-- pr-reviewer: 63beeab2fc2d03039cd1adbbbf8251605af3be40 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The split meets issue #1849. The public method path stays the same. Each file has fewer than 400 lines. The new test adds one test; it removes no tests.

I checked the digest code with extra care because it controls when a stored toolpath becomes stale. All 37 original match-arm blocks and the full link trailer match the old text. Each operation kind goes to the correct family method. The shared writers keep the same byte order and height resolution logic. There are no changes to G-code output logic, geometry algorithms, collision checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. No UI, dependency, build script, or workflow changed.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at 31f8d03d7:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed in 210 seconds. App unit tests: 334 passed, 1 ignored. Suites: adaptive_trochoid 12, contour_start_point 8, lead_approach 6, level_links 25, pocket3d_hsm 1 (1 ignored), sinker_burn 14, sinker_orbit 7, sinker_side 6, sinker_undersize 10, slot_extension 5, trochoid_op 5, turning_profile 6, wire_stamp 7. Total: 446 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- I compiled the PR's size test with `rustc --test` against source copies in `/tmp`. The current files passed. Restoring the old unsplit file failed at 1798 lines. Restoring the split passed. Adding 401 lines to a child module failed at 605 lines. Restoring that child passed. These checks did not change the PR source.

The gate reported two tests above 60 seconds. Both passed. I did not run ignored tests or repeat the author's temporary 132-case digest comparison. I checked the moved code against main instead.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
